verdict.rationale: Medusa's Cloud offering supports GitHub-based deployment, source-code ownership, and 'Instant previews on PRs', which implies git-style versioning and review of custom code/workflows, but there is no evidence of automation-specific version history, diff/review UI, or one-click rollback for workflows or agent-built automations. Missing for 10: dedicated automation/workflow versioning system, review workflow beyond generic PR previews, explicit rollback mechanism for automations, and any independent confirmation of these capabilities in practice.
